title: kate-ui: group the search hits by file
summary: searchpane.rs groups FileHit values by path in first-seen order, formats one hit as line:col: text, and builds the SearchQuery from the pane toggles. The pane paints the groups in the next packet.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create searchpane.rs with the SPDX header and add mod searchpane; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute. The test group_by_file_keeps_first_seen_order builds hits for b.rs, a.rs, b.rs and asserts two groups, b.rs first with two hits, and that hit_label of line 0 col 2 text x is 1:3: x. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: searchpane::tests::group_by_file_keeps_first_seen_order
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because searchpane.rs does not exist. After the change hits group by path in first-seen order and the label is one-based.
